meta.title: Juvo BD: fashion, shoes, dresses and purses
meta.description: Order clothing, shoes, ladies' dresses and purses from Juvo BD with a mobile number, and follow every delivery step live.

shell.menuHelp: Choose a page. Swipe left or press Escape to close.
shell.search: Search and jump to a page
shell.searchHelp: Type to find a page, then press Enter.
shell.noNotificationsBody: New orders, low stock and delivery problems will appear here.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Welcome back to Juvo BD.
auth.authenticatorHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.recoveryHint: One of the recovery codes you saved. Each works once.
auth.mobileHint: For example 01712345678. We send a code by SMS.
auth.otpHint: 6 digits. The code is valid for 5 minutes.
auth.reasonExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
auth.reasonTwoFactor: Two-step verification is on. Sign in again and enter the code from your app.
auth.reasonPasswordChanged: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, we send a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSentBody: If that email belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
auth.resetDone: Your password was changed. All devices were signed out.
auth.passwordRules: At least 10 characters with an upper case letter, a lower case letter, a number and a symbol.

errors.identifierRequired: Enter your email or user name.
errors.passwordSymbol: Add a symbol such as ! or #.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.passwordSame: Choose a password different from the current one.
errors.currentWrong: The current password is not correct.

twoFactor.recoveryBody: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.intro: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app on your phone, in addition to your password.
twoFactor.step1: Open an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar) and scan this code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
twoFactor.orKey: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app:
twoFactor.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm.

firstLogin.title: Finish setting up your account
firstLogin.passwordBody: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose a permanent one to continue.
firstLogin.twoFactorBody: Two-step verification is required for this account.
firstLogin.twoFactorNotice: When you finish, you will sign in again with your new code.

security.passwordHelp: Changing your password signs you out of your other devices.
security.twoFactorOn: On. A code from your app is needed to sign in.
security.twoFactorOff: Off. Add a second step to protect your account.
security.mandatory: Two-step verification is required for Super Admin and cannot be turned off.
security.newRecoveryCodes: New recovery codes. The old ones no longer work. Save these now.

sessions.title: Where you are signed in
sessions.description: Devices that can open your account. Sign out any you do not recognise.

profile.title: My profile and security
profile.subtitle: Your details, password, two-step verification and devices.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your access and the state of the system. Business widgets arrive with the order and stock modules.
dashboard.workingInHelp: Lists and reports follow the active branch.
dashboard.chooseBranchHint: Choose a branch in the top bar to work in it.
dashboard.branchCount: {count, plural, one {You can use 1 branch} other {You can use # branches}}
dashboard.systemHelp: The server this panel is connected to.
dashboard.accessHelp: Permissions you hold in the active branch, by module.
dashboard.allPermissions: You hold every permission, including new ones (catalog {version}).
dashboard.noPermissions: You hold no permissions in this branch. Choose another branch or ask an administrator.
dashboard.cannotManageUsers: User management is not available to you.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Your details and the devices signed in to your account. Orders, addresses and the wishlist arrive with the shop.
account.profileHelp: Your mobile number is how we recognise you.
account.name: Name

storefront.tagline: Fashion, shoes, ladies' dresses and purses, delivered across Bangladesh.
storefront.heroTitle: Fashion you will love, delivered to your door
storefront.heroBody: Clothing, shoes, ladies' dresses and purses. Order with just your mobile number and follow every step of the delivery.
storefront.trust1Body: Just your mobile number and delivery address. No account needed.
storefront.trust2Body: Trusted couriers with live tracking from packing to your door.
storefront.trust3Body: Pay when your order arrives, or pay online when you prefer.
storefront.trust4Body: Not right? Ask for a return or exchange within the return window.

errorPages.notFoundTitle: We could not find that page
errorPages.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped. Let us take you back to a page that works.
errorPages.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
errorPages.forbiddenBody: Your account does not have permission here in the branch you are working in. Choose another branch or ask an administrator.
errorPages.unauthorizedBody: Your session ended or you are not signed in yet.
errorPages.errorTitle: Something went wrong on our side
errorPages.errorBody: We could not show this page. Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell us the reference number below.

errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.GENERAL_UNEXPECTED: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.GENERAL_UNREACHABLE: The server could not be reached. Please try again in a moment.
errors.GENERAL_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.GENERAL_BAD_REQUEST: Please check what you entered and try again.
errors.GENERAL_CONFLICT: That is no longer possible because something changed. Reload and try again.
errors.GENERAL_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this record. Reload and try again.
errors.AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email, user name, password or code is not correct.
errors.AUTH_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for a few minutes.
errors.AUTH_TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is disabled. Please contact the administrator.
errors.AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.AUTH_REFRESH_REUSED: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
errors.AUTH_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.AUTH_BRANCH_FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this branch.
errors.AUTH_WEAK_PASSWORD: That password does not meet the rules. Use at least 10 characters with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol.
errors.AUTH_RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: This reset link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.AUTH_OTP_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.AUTH_OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.AUTH_OTP_COOLDOWN: Please wait a minute before asking for another code.
errors.AUTH_INVALID_MOBILE: Enter a valid mobile number, for example 01712345678.
